weapon.d: During unit's first combat in player phase or enemy phase, grants Atk/Res+5 to unit and restores 7 HP to unit after combat.
During unit's first combat in player phase or enemy phase, grants Atk/Res+5 to unit and restores 7 HP to unit after combat.

For allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Res+5 and neutralizes foe's bonuses during combat, and restores 7 HP after their combat.
If unit is within 3 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit, neutralizes foe's bonuses, reduces damage from foe's attacks by 7 (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack during combat, and restores 7 HP to unit after combat.

assist.d:
Restores 10 HP to target ally.
Unit loses 10 HP but cannot go below 1.

a.d: If foe initiates combat, grants Res+2 during combat.
If foe initiates combat, grants Spd/Res+2 during combat.
If foe initiates combat, grants Spd/Res+4 during combat.

c.d: At start of turn, grants Atk+2 to ally with the highest Atk for 1 turn. (Excludes unit.)
At start of turn, grants Atk+4 to ally with the highest Atk for 1 turn. (Excludes unit.)
At start of turn, grants Atk+6 to ally with the highest Atk for 1 turn. (Excludes unit.)
